### Profile: `pizza_order_test_custom`

This profile is designed for ordering a pizza and includes the following relevant outputs:
- `price`: The final price of the pizza order.
- `time`: The opening time.
- `order_id`: The order ID.

### Rule: `more_toppings_cost_more`

This rule checks if adding more toppings to a custom pizza costs more. It looks like this:

```yaml
active: true
conversations: 2
description: Adding more toppings to a custom pizza cost more
if: 'len(conv[0].toppings) > len(conv[1].toppings)'

then: 'extract_float(conv[0].price) > extract_float(conv[1].price)'
when: 'conv[0].size == conv[1].size and conv[0].drink == conv[1].drink'
```

```yaml

then: 'extract_float(conv[0].price) == extract_float(conv[1].price)'
when: 'conv[0].drink == conv[1].drink'
```
